answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by placing every identity in a bonded collateral escrow and correlating its votes, timing, and signatures. When k identities coordinate equivocation, the protocol applies a quadratic slash, O(k^2), to exposed collateral; detection then adds an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making a controlled swarm economically untenable rather than merely k times costly. The delta, quill, and sparrow labels aid attribution; asymmetric depreciation blocks replacement.
